# Sales Order Analysis: January to June 2026

## Method
- **Order value** = quantity × unit price × (1 − discount%).
- **Net revenue** = the sum of order values for orders with status "Completed" only.

## q1: Net revenue in March 2026

There were 18 completed orders in March:

580 + 190 + 1,368 + 1,435.50 + 652.50 + 331.50 + 1,740 + 161.50 + 137.75 + 1,515.25 + 494 + 714 + 1,102 + 390 + 1,595 + 216.60 + 756 + 324.90 = **£13,704.50**

## q2: Region with the highest net revenue in Q2

| Region | April | May | June | Q2 total |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| North | 1,134.00 | 4,671.00 | 3,733.50 | **9,538.50** |
| East | 3,080.75 | 4,762.50 | 1,335.00 | 9,178.25 |
| South | 4,515.00 | 1,680.00 | 1,182.00 | 7,377.00 |
| West | 2,811.00 | 971.00 | 535.50 | 4,317.50 |

**North** had the highest net revenue in Q2. The four regions add up to £30,411.25.

## q3: Product growth from Q1 to Q2

| Product | Q1 | Q2 | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| Standing Desk | 6,300.00 | 13,188.00 | **+109.33%** |
| Desk Chair | 13,920.00 | 7,438.50 | −46.6% |
| Filing Cabinet | 13,734.00 | 6,381.00 | −53.5% |
| Monitor Arm | 4,758.00 | 1,342.25 | −71.8% |
| Desk Lamp | 2,268.60 | 1,016.50 | −55.2% |
| Whiteboard | 6,141.75 | 1,045.00 | −83.0% |

**Standing Desk** grew the most, by (13,188 − 6,300) / 6,300 = **109.33%**. It was the only product that grew.

## q4: Order value lost to refunded and cancelled orders

- **Cancelled orders:** 390 + 117 + 130.50 + 760 + 1,680 = £3,077.50
- **Refunded orders:** 247 + 137.75 + 1,197 + 580 + 1,140 + 165.75 + 540 + 247 + 679.25 + 702 + 798 + 643.50 + 688.75 = £7,766.00
- **Total lost: £10,843.50**

## q5: Top customer, January to June

**Brookside Dental** had the highest net revenue:

180 + 1,160 + 390 + 855 + 1,260 + 1,515.25 + 1,134 + 1,680 + 652.50 = **£8,826.75**

The next highest were Linden Travel (£6,859.50) and Maple Court Surgery (£6,382.15).

## q6: Average net order value in Q1

| Month | Net revenue | Completed orders |
|---|---|---|
| January | 18,913.10 | 26 |
| February | 14,504.75 | 20 |
| March | 13,704.50 | 18 |
| **Q1 total** | **47,122.35** | **64** |

Average = 47,122.35 / 64 = **£736.29**
